summary: R58 exact member-visibility surface, omission, lattice, and original-slot override admission; product checker NOT_RUN.
requires: the shared MemberVisibility surface is exactly +, -, or # on one of the 15 current MemberVisibility? owner productions
member visibility omission remains OMITTED with normalized visibility null and has no global default
an override or fulfillment retains the ORIGINAL_DECLARING_NOMINAL_SLOT anchor and cannot select a narrower visibility
member visibility is a static source and checker law and creates no runtime behavior
preconditions: the parser preserves the member owner production and the exact optional visibility token
override resolution, when present, provides the original slot anchor and its admitted visibility
normalization: preserve +, -, and # exactly and normalize them to PUBLIC, PRIVATE, and HIERARCHY_PROTECTED; preserve omission as OMITTED/null; assign comparison ranks -=0, #=1, +=2 without synthesizing a default
decision_procedure: require the declaration owner to be one of the 15 grammar productions that directly admit MemberVisibility?
if a member callable uses common, private, protected, or public, reject with CALLABLE_VISIBILITY_KEYWORD_FORBIDDEN
otherwise preserve an explicit +, -, or # token and normalize it to PUBLIC, PRIVATE, or HIERARCHY_PROTECTED, or preserve absence as omission_state OMITTED and semantic value null
for a non-override declaration, seal the static MemberVisibilityFact without adding runtime state
for an override or fulfillment, retain original_slot_anchor_id as the comparison anchor
compare explicit visibility ranks in the exact lattice - < # < + and reject an override rank below its original slot rank with OVERRIDE_VISIBILITY_CANNOT_NARROW
otherwise return the admitted static MemberVisibilityFact
termination_metric: one finite member declaration and at most one original-slot visibility comparison
evaluation_order: owner admission -> exact surface or OMITTED/null preservation -> original slot anchor -> lattice comparison -> deterministic diagnostic
